messages:
olivia: quick draft RN + rollout sketch for v2.3.2 (quant stability patch). Need a pin owner, copycheck, and someone to watch rollback gates. Plan below.

olivia: RN draft:
• Update: v2.3.2-stable-quant — stability fixes to quant kernels, minor perf uplift on long sequences (~10-15%), and reduced streaming stalls.
• Fix: patch for rare OOM during KV cache refill on 32k contexts.
• Note: routing unchanged, but dedicated fallback to v2.3.1 remains enabled.

olivia: rollout sketch: canary 4% -> 20% after 15m -> 60% after 45m -> 100% after 90m. Rollback gates: 3x error rate within 3 min OR sustained p95 > 700ms for 10m. Enable debug logging for canary for first 20m.

matt: timeline ok from infra. I can own the model pin + run. Proposed model id: model-redwood/v2.3.2-stable-q, stack: inference-v2.3. Any objections?

emily: copy nit: change "stability fixes" -> "stability and latency regressions mitigated". Also add a one-liner for customer-facing note: "Minor rollout to improve stability and reduce occasional streaming stalls; brief warmup expected."

jordan: i will take rollback watch and the final go/no-go. i'll wire alerts and short heartbeat. ping me on promote -> 20%.

matt: deploy-bot params i'll schedule at 2025-06-12T16:00:00Z. commands below.

deploy-bot: deploy scheduled by @matt. job id: db-1798881234. params: 
```
deploy-bot run db-1798881234 --stage canary --percent 4 --wait 900 --debug-logs true
deploy-bot promote db-1798881234 --percent 20 --wait 1800 --dns-hold 300
deploy-bot promote db-1798881234 --percent 60 --wait 2700
deploy-bot promote db-1798881234 --percent 100
deploy-bot rollback db-1798881234 --reason "rollback gate triggered"
```

jordan: please add a small DNS hold after the 20% promote to avoid flipflop; matt already added --dns-hold 300 in the promote above, thanks. i'll also temporarily lower the alert threshold for canary to catch any spike.

emily: docs will push an internal snippet at T-10 and prep the release notes page. Suggested internal snippet: "Heads up: v2.3.2 rolling at 16:00 UTC — stability and minor perf improvements. Ops monitoring. Will post updates."

olivia: updated RN per emily. final checklist: model pin set to model-redwood/v2.3.2-stable-q, deploy job scheduled, rollback watch assigned to jordan, internal blurb ready. Go/no-go check at 15:45 UTC.

matt: will set job to queued and report at 15:45.

deploy-bot: job db-1798881234 created and queued by @matt.
